text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hi there, Goddesses! ♪ How are you<n>doing?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: You called me here, right? I heard<n>your voices.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Did you have some business with<n>me?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Strange... I could've sworn I heard a<n>voice just
now.
